title.zh: 可重复使用水瓶 · 生命周期研究

subtitle.en: Synthetic demonstration — illustrates the report interface, not measured environmental performance.
subtitle.zh: 合成演示数据——用于展示报告能力，不代表实测环境表现。

body.en:
Functional unit: one bottle at the factory gate.
The illustrative system includes material preparation and assembly. Use and end-of-life are outside this demonstration.
body.zh:
功能单位：一只出厂水瓶。
示例系统包含材料准备和装配。本演示不包含使用及报废阶段。

body.en: All values below are supplied by the caller. The renderer does not calculate, translate or infer providers.
body.zh: 以下数值均由调用方提供。渲染器不执行计算、翻译或供应者推断。

details.en: An explicitly selected aggregated background. Its upstream graph is not expanded.
details.zh: 显式选择的聚合背景，不展开其上游过程。

details.en: Synthetic foreground operation with a declared electricity input.
details.zh: 声明电力投入的合成前景过程。

details.en: Reference output: one bottle. Connection amounts describe the supplied model, not renderer-derived scaling.
details.zh: 参考产出为一只水瓶。连接数量来自提供的模型，并非渲染器推算。

note.en: Synthetic source; no user or production data.
note.zh: 合成来源，不包含用户或生产数据。

note.en: Example link and invented values for interface testing only.
note.zh: 示例链接及虚构数值，仅用于接口测试。

limitations.en: These values cannot support a real product comparison. Replace them with actual selected Run results and explain their scope before drawing scientific conclusions.
limitations.zh: 这些数值不能用于真实产品比较。形成科学结论前，应替换为所选 Run 的实际结果并解释其适用范围。

limitations.en: No per-node impact contribution data was supplied; the report does not infer contributions from totals.
limitations.zh: 未提供节点影响贡献数据；报告不会从总量推断贡献。
